answer.summary: ArchUnit rule TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest.payload_identities_repository_access_is_reviewed fails deterministically. The changed PayloadInstallNotificationListener.notifications calls PayloadIdentity.getRepository() at PayloadInstallNotificationListener.java:48, which the architecture rule forbids. The file is in this change, so a rerun will fail the same way; fix the repository access or the rule baseline. The other failing-job signals (Jackson '<' parse error, cause1/cause2 logs) are unrelated noise.
